{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794655074910,"sessionID":"ses_e263e2646ffeVdZ6f6zVXPoMmN","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"EoEg4H41Tgw0M2DL","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"workdir":"/tmp/opencode","command":"python3 -c '\n# Compute exact Bayesian posterior over the 7 Sales employees from Days 1-4 access logs + interviews\n# Note: e25 (Legal) is the decoy. None of the 7 Sales employees is the decoy.\n# For each day d in 1..4:\n# Each employee has normal accesses ~ Poisson(1.0).\n# For mole: each normal access is after_hours with p=0.3 (so AH_own ~ Poisson(0.3), Day_own ~ Poisson(0.7)), zero framing received!\n# For innocent non-decoy: Day_own ~ Poisson(0.9), AH_own ~ Poisson(0.1), PLUS framing AH ~ Poisson(1.0/38) baseline (+ maybe 1/39 if DSL frames random colleague).\nimport math\n\nsales = [\"e02\", \"e07\", \"e09\", \"e15\", \"e17\", \"e37\", \"e39\"]\n# Total accesses (daytime, after_hours) over 4 days (Days 1..4):\nlogs = {\n    \"e02\": (4, 0),\n    \"e07\": (6, 3),\n    \"e09\": (4, 0),\n    \"e15\": (6, 0),\n    \"e17\": (5, 0),\n    \"e37\": (5, 1),\n    \"e39\": (2, 2),\n}\n# Interviews (evasive, cooperative):\ninterviews = {\n    \"e02\": (0, 0),\n    \"e07\": (2, 1),\n    \"e09\": (0, 0),\n    \"e15\": (0, 1),\n    \"e17\": (0, 0),\n    \"e37\": (0, 1),\n    \"e39\": (0, 3),\n}\n\ndef pois_pmf(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\nfor extra_frame_rate in [0.0, 1.0/38]:\n    lam_ah_inn = 4 * (0.1 + 1.0/38 + extra_frame_rate)\n    lam_day_inn = 4 * 0.9\n    lam_ah_mole = 4 * 0.3\n    lam_day_mole = 4 * 0.7\n    \n    weights = {}\n    for s in sales:\n        d_cnt, ah_cnt = logs[s]\n        ev, coop = interviews[s]\n        # Likelihood ratio Mole / Innocent for employee s:\n        lr_logs = (pois_pmf(d_cnt, lam_day_mole) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah_mole)) / (pois_pmf(d_cnt, lam_day_inn) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah_inn))\n        lr_int = ((0.24 / 0.20) ** ev) * ((0.76 / 0.80) ** coop)\n        weights[s] = lr_logs * lr_int\n    tot = sum(weights.values())\n    print(f\"extra_frame={extra_frame_rate:.4f}:\", {s: round(weights[s]/tot, 4) for s in sales})\n'"},"output":"extra_frame=0.0000: {'e02': 0.0413, 'e07': 0.4583, 'e09': 0.0413, 'e15': 0.0238, 'e17': 0.0322, 'e37': 0.0726, 'e39': 0.3305}\nextra_frame=0.0263: {'e02': 0.0604, 'e07': 0.3794, 'e09': 0.0604, 'e15': 0.0347, 'e17': 0.047, 'e37': 0.0877, 'e39': 0.3306}\n","metadata":{"output":"extra_frame=0.0000: {'e02': 0.0413, 'e07': 0.4583, 'e09': 0.0413, 'e15': 0.0238, 'e17': 0.0322, 'e37': 0.0726, 'e39': 0.3305}\nextra_frame=0.0263: {'e02': 0.0604, 'e07': 0.3794, 'e09': 0.0604, 'e15': 0.0347, 'e17': 0.047, 'e37': 0.0877, 'e39': 0.3306}\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"python3 -c '\n# Compute exact Bayesian posterior over the 7 Sales employees from Days 1-4 access logs + interviews\n# Note: e25 (Legal) is the decoy. None of the 7 Sales employees is the decoy.\n# For each day d in 1..4:\n# Each employee has normal accesses ~ Poisson(1.0).\n# For mole: each normal access is after_hours with p=0.3 (so AH_own ~ Poisson(0.3), Day_own ~ Poisson(0.7)), zero framing received!\n# For innocent non-decoy: Day_own ~ Poisson(0.9), AH_own ~ Poisson(0.1), PLUS framing AH ~ Poisson(1.0/38) baseline (+ maybe 1/39 if DSL frames random colleague).\nimport math\n\nsales = [\"e02\", \"e07\", \"e09\", \"e15\", \"e17\", \"e37\", \"e39\"]\n# Total accesses (daytime, after_hours) over 4 days (Days 1..4):\nlogs = {\n    \"e02\": (4, 0),\n    \"e07\": (6, 3),\n    \"e09\": (4, 0),\n    \"e15\": (6, 0),\n    \"e17\": (5, 0),\n    \"e37\": (5, 1),\n    \"e39\": (2, 2),\n}\n# Interviews (evasive, cooperative):\ninterviews = {\n    \"e02\": (0, 0),\n    \"e07\": (2, 1),\n    \"e09\": (0, 0),\n    \"e15\": (0, 1),\n    \"e17\": (0, 0),\n    \"e37\": (0, 1),\n    \"e39\": (0, 3),\n}\n\ndef pois_pmf(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\nfor extra_frame_rate in [0.0, 1.0/38]:\n    lam_ah_inn = 4 * (0.1 + 1.0/38 + extra_frame_rate)\n    lam_day_inn = 4 * 0.9\n    lam_ah_mole = 4 * 0.3\n    lam_day_mole = 4 * 0.7\n    \n    weights = {}\n    for s in sales:\n        d_cnt, ah_cnt = logs[s]\n        ev, coop = interviews[s]\n        # Likelihood ratio Mole / Innocent for employee s:\n        lr_logs = (pois_pmf(d_cnt, lam_day_mole) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah_mole)) / (pois_pmf(d_cnt, lam_day_inn) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah_inn))\n        lr_int = ((0.24 / 0.20) ** ev) * ((0.76 / 0.80) ** coop)\n        weights[s] = lr_logs * lr_int\n    tot = sum(weights.values())\n    print(f\"extra_frame={extra_frame_rate:.4f}:\", {s: round(weights[s]/tot, 4) for s in sales})\n'","time":{"start":1794655074836,"end":1794655074909}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d9c73a0e00194qHZLrplVNiua","sessionID":"ses_e263e2646ffeVdZ6f6zVXPoMmN","messageID":"msg_1d9c68b2c001427Hhz4md7WzVr"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794655175209,"sessionID":"ses_e263e2646ffeVdZ6f6zVXPoMmN","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"LfbB7hqIweHUkmcI","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"workdir":"/tmp/opencode","command":"python3 -c '\nimport math\n\n# Check Days 1..6 logs for e02, e09, e15, e17:\n# Day 1: e02(1,0), e09(1,0), e15(2,0), e17(2,0)\n# Day 2: e02(1,0), e09(1,0), e15(1,0), e17(1,0)\n# Day 3: e02(2,0), e09(2,0), e15(0,0), e17(0,0)\n# Day 4: e02(0,0), e09(0,0), e15(3,0), e17(2,0)\n# Day 5: e02(2,0), e09(1,0), e15(0,0), e17(1,0)\n# Day 6: e02(1,0), e09(2,1), e15(3,0), e17(0,0)\n\nlogs = {\n    \"e02\": (7, 0),\n    \"e09\": (7, 1),\n    \"e15\": (9, 0),\n    \"e17\": (6, 0),\n}\ninterviews = {\n    \"e02\": (1, 0), # evasive on Day 5!\n    \"e09\": (0, 0),\n    \"e15\": (0, 1), # coop on Day 2\n    \"e17\": (0, 0),\n}\ncanary_like = {\n    \"e02\": 0.95,\n    \"e09\": 0.025,\n    \"e15\": 0.025,\n    \"e17\": 0.025,\n}\n\ndef pois_pmf(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\nfor extra_frame in [0.0, 1.0/38]:\n    lam_ah_inn = 6 * (0.1 + 1.0/38 + extra_frame)\n    lam_day_inn = 6 * 0.9\n    lam_ah_mole = 6 * 0.3\n    lam_day_mole = 6 * 0.7\n    w = {}\n    for s in [\"e02\", \"e09\", \"e15\", \"e17\"]:\n        d_cnt, ah_cnt = logs[s]\n        ev, coop = interviews[s]\n        lr_logs = (pois_pmf(d_cnt, lam_day_mole) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah_mole)) / (pois_pmf(d_cnt, lam_day_inn) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah_inn))\n        lr_int = ((0.24 / 0.20) ** ev) * ((0.76 / 0.80) ** coop)\n        w[s] = canary_like[s] * lr_logs * lr_int\n    tot = sum(w.values())\n    p = {s: round(w[s]/tot, 5) for s in w}\n    print(f\"extra_frame={extra_frame:.4f}:\", p)\n'"},"output":"extra_frame=0.0000: {'e02': 0.91501, 'e09': 0.04766, 'e15': 0.01153, 'e17': 0.0258}\nextra_frame=0.0263: {'e02': 0.92259, 'e09': 0.03977, 'e15': 0.01163, 'e17': 0.02601}\n","metadata":{"output":"extra_frame=0.0000: {'e02': 0.91501, 'e09': 0.04766, 'e15': 0.01153, 'e17': 0.0258}\nextra_frame=0.0263: {'e02': 0.92259, 'e09': 0.03977, 'e15': 0.01163, 'e17': 0.02601}\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"python3 -c '\nimport math\n\n# Check Days 1..6 logs for e02, e09, e15, e17:\n# Day 1: e02(1,0), e09(1,0), e15(2,0), e17(2,0)\n# Day 2: e02(1,0), e09(1,0), e15(1,0), e17(1,0)\n# Day 3: e02(2,0), e09(2,0), e15(0,0), e17(0,0)\n# Day 4: e02(0,0), e09(0,0), e15(3,0), e17(2,0)\n# Day 5: e02(2,0), e09(1,0), e15(0,0), e17(1,0)\n# Day 6: e02(1,0), e09(2,1), e15(3,0), e17(0,0)\n\nlogs = {\n    \"e02\": (7, 0),\n    \"e09\": (7, 1),\n    \"e15\": (9, 0),\n    \"e17\": (6, 0),\n}\ninterviews = {\n    \"e02\": (1, 0), # evasive on Day 5!\n    \"e09\": (0, 0),\n    \"e15\": (0, 1), # coop on Day 2\n    \"e17\": (0, 0),\n}\ncanary_like = {\n    \"e02\": 0.95,\n    \"e09\": 0.025,\n    \"e15\": 0.025,\n    \"e17\": 0.025,\n}\n\ndef pois_pmf(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\nfor extra_frame in [0.0, 1.0/38]:\n    lam_ah_inn = 6 * (0.1 + 1.0/38 + extra_frame)\n    lam_day_inn = 6 * 0.9\n    lam_ah_mole = 6 * 0.3\n    lam_day_mole = 6 * 0.7\n    w = {}\n    for s in [\"e02\", \"e09\", \"e15\", \"e17\"]:\n        d_cnt, ah_cnt = logs[s]\n        ev, coop = interviews[s]\n        lr_logs = (pois_pmf(d_cnt, lam_day_mole) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah_mole)) / (pois_pmf(d_cnt, lam_day_inn) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah_inn))\n        lr_int = ((0.24 / 0.20) ** ev) * ((0.76 / 0.80) ** coop)\n        w[s] = canary_like[s] * lr_logs * lr_int\n    tot = sum(w.values())\n    p = {s: round(w[s]/tot, 5) for s in w}\n    print(f\"extra_frame={extra_frame:.4f}:\", p)\n'","time":{"start":1794655175191,"end":1794655175208}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d9c8c20a00143nwAhy39FTHCF","sessionID":"ses_e263e2646ffeVdZ6f6zVXPoMmN","messageID":"msg_1d9c864b40011BTB6d3MVGsqmu"}}
